area.title: Video segments
area.caption: Materialized video segments of this match
area.note: Purged segments are rematerialized on demand when a later analysis job needs them.

empty: This match has no video segments yet. Segments are created on demand when an analysis needs them.
notPermitted: Only Club Admins can see and manage the video segments of a match.
error: The video segments could not be loaded.
offline: Video segment management needs a connection. Reconnect to see or change the segments.

purge.nothingToPurge: Nothing to purge: every segment is in use or already absent.
purge.confirmTitle: Purge the unused segments of this match?
purge.confirmBody: The unused video segments of the match against {{opponent}} are deleted and become absent. Segments that are in use by waiting, ready, or claimed jobs are kept and reported. A purged segment is rematerialized on demand when a later job needs it.
purge.outcome: {{purged}} segments purged, {{inUse}} kept because they are in use.
purge.failure: The segments could not be purged. Segments already purged by the call stay purged.
